_comment: Pterodactyl Minecraft Multi-Profile Manager v2.2.0. Stable release with SERVER_MEMORY=0 support, imported-server detection from logs/versions, automatic Java selection, Unicode profile names, and per-profile switch backups.
name: Minecraft Multi-Profile Manager v2.2.0
author: local@example.com
description: Store many Minecraft servers under /home/container/servers and run exactly one at a time on a single Pterodactyl allocation. Supports Unicode profile names, profile.conf overrides, server/Minecraft version detection, automatic Java runtime selection and caching, safe profile validation, Primary Allocation port enforcement, and per-profile switch backups.

variables.name: Server Profile
variables.description: Folder name under /home/container/servers to run. Unicode letters and numbers are supported (for example: 마크서버). Stop the server, change this value, then start again.

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set true only if you accept the Minecraft EULA. Applied to the selected profile.

variables.name: Automatic Backup On Profile Switch
variables.description: Global fallback. Individual profile.conf files can override BACKUP_ON_SWITCH.

variables.name: Backup Retention
variables.description: Default number of backups kept per profile. profile.conf can override BACKUP_KEEP.

variables.name: Initial Paper Version
variables.description: Used only when the Egg installer creates servers/default. Use latest or an exact version.

variables.name: Custom Initial Download URL
variables.description: Optional admin-only jar URL for initial servers/default creation.

variables.name: Custom Initial Download SHA-256
variables.description: Optional admin-only SHA-256 for DL_PATH. Official Paper downloads always use the API checksum.
